   **Баги и стабильность.**
      17 свежих отзыв(ов) упоминают: баги и стабильность.
      Период отзывов: 22 июл. 2026 г. - 7 окт. 2026 г.
      **Что это значит:** Пользователи упоминают краши или нестабильность. Это actionable только при всплеске или после обновления; иначе часто baseline-шум.

         **Примеры отзывов:**
            1. _Tomito6_, 2 окт. 2026 г., 1/5: "I payed this app for almost a year. Not worth it at all! I found a much better app that was not 20€ per month. And let me tell you that this app also often didn’t work. It’s super buggy!! For some reason my instagram always seemed to unlock between 23-24 (even if I put a lot of extra rules or changed stuff) it also often didn’t revognize time limits so it’s quite literally not doing it’s only purpose, while demanding 20€. Hoooorrrribble app. Migrated to a new one and wish I could go back in time to avoid this scam"
            2. _A136P_, 24 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "I was using this app for over a year and really liked it. At some point that had a huge system update and since then it would glitch constantly and lag. I have ended up deleting it as a result"
            3. _AverageMean_, 13 сент. 2026 г., 1/5: "used to love the app but its filled with bugs (apps not blocking or blocking in loops when unblocked, spamming notifications…) since the 4.x update :( is there any way to get the old app back?"
